identity.title: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Scarlet & Violet Arc

leadText:

(Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Scarlet & Violet Arc) is a by Ryū Matsushima based on the Pokémon Trading Card Game. It is serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine, with the first three chapters published in the March 2023 issue, released on January 20, 2023. It is the sequel of Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc. It tells the story of Retto Mirai (Japanese: Mirai Retto) and Retto (Japanese: Retto).

Like its predecessor, this manga is collected into volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: Let's Start! Scarlet & Violet! Arc) and (Japanese: Shine! Terastal! Arc). Each volume is 192 pages long.
